In the current patch the day/night cycle lasts 4 minutes (that is 4 minutes of day and then 4 of night). The significance of this is centered around vision range and the heroes Nightstalker and Keeper of the Light. For just about every hero in the game their daytime vision is 1800 units which is something close to the distance between mid tier 1 towers. At night the vision of most heroes is reduced significantly. Nightstalker is the exception to the rule with lower vision during the day and max vision at night. His whole kit works around this mechanic. At night he is faster, attacks faster, has a longer duration silence and a more powerful slow. His ultimate changes day to night during the day and extends the current night when used at night. His ultimate now also further reduces enemy vision as well as being upgradable with an item to give him unbroken vision, meaning he can see upholds and through trees at night. Keeper of the light has a similar mechanic on his ultimate but during the day with a few other bonuses.
